data: What is the color of the cell representing the system's accuracy for predicting 'sr' when the true label is 'bs'?

The question asks about the color of the cell representing the system's accuracy for predicting 'sr' when the true label is 'bs'. From the caption, we know this corresponds to the cell at the intersection of 'sr' on the predicted label axis and 'bs' on the true label axis. 

Looking at the figure, the color of this cell is yellow. This can be verified by checking the color bar on the right side of the figure, which indicates that yellow corresponds to a low value of accuracy (approximately 0.1). Therefore, the color of the cell is yellow.
